name: git-vibe
description: GitVibe - AI Agent Orchestration with Patch Management

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:shared
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../shared && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && cd backend && npm run db:migrate
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:shared
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend && npm run format:shared
